create_object_tracking: create an ObjectTracking instance with a norfair Tracker for real-time 2D object tracking
run_tracker_on_frame: run the tracker on an rgb_depth frame with detections to get tracked objects
convert_detections_to_norfair: convert detection objects to norfair Detection format using the to_norfair method
review_object_tracking_init: review the ObjectTracking class init to understand euclidean distance function and tracker configuration
debug_draw_tracked_objects: debug draw tracked objects on the image using DEBUG_DRAW environment variable
